preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in a)
preconditions.description: All characters in string a are either '0' or '1'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in b)
preconditions.description: All characters in string b are either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if len(a) == len(b) and sum(int(c) for c in a) == sum(int(c) for c in b) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The transformation is possible if and only if the strings a and b have the same length and the same number of '1's.
